name: Fiuheim
source:
The materialized form of Iris' sword, he has mysterious shadow powers that Iris doesn't seem to remember. As the sword housing him was chipped in an accident, his memory is a bit jumbled. Shy and sweet around her, Fiuheim is quiet and detached towards almost everyone else.

His dependence on Iris is a bit concerning, but there seems to be a deep reason for this. Despite his attachment towards her, he's willing to do what makes Iris happy, even if that means tragedy for him. 

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12568544.fiuheim]official bio[/url]]
